--------------------- Create External Table

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE parquetTable
(

    STUDYID varchar (100),
    DOMAIN varchar (100),
    USUBJID varchar (100),
    CMSEQ varchar (100),
    CMTRT varchar (100),
    CMDECOD varchar (100),
    CMDOSE varchar (100),
    CMDOSU varchar (100),
    CMROUTE varchar (100),
    CMSTDTC varchar (100),
    CMENDTC varchar (100),
    CMINDC varchar (100),
    MODIFIED_TS varchar (100)

)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '/cr-synapsetest/CM_20260720061232.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = sqlfilehandling,
    FILE_FORMAT = ff_parquet
);

select * from parquetTable;

select * from parquetTable
where CMINDC ='Pain';

select CMINDC , COUNT (*) as Total from parquetTable group by CMINDC;

-- DISTRIBUTION Type
--  1) Hash Key 
--  1) ROUND_ROBIN
--  3) Replicate

create table dbo.VS
(
    STUDYID varchar(100),
    DOMAIN varchar(100),
    USUBJID varchar(100),
    VSSEQ varchar(100),
    VSTESTCD varchar(100),
    VSTEST varchar(100),
    VSORRES varchar(100),
    VSORRESU varchar(100),
    VISITNUM varchar(100),
    VISIT varchar(100),
    VSDTC varchar(100),
    MoDIFIED_TS  varchar(100)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH (STUDYID)
);
select * from dbo.VS
select COUNT(*) from dbo.VS

COPY INTO [dbo].[vs] FROM 'https://stsynapseclintrial.blob.core.windows.net/landing/VS.csv'
